consequence.statement: The async_cache_write_back_concurrency configuration setting will no longer be honoured and must be migrated to writeback_goroutines in the Background cache configuration.

assertion.statement: The configuration keys async_cache_write_back_concurrency and async_cache_write_back_buffer_size have been removed in favor of Background cache configuration settings (writeback_goroutines, writeback_buffer, and writeback_size_limit).

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for config-key removed
